_doc: Shared ADR-005 Tier-2 dual-driver parity fixture for the revm inspector. Both rust/crates/degenbot/tests/parity_inspector.rs (Rust consumer: simulate_in_process_with_db directly) and tests/standalone_parity/test_inspector_dual_driver.py (Python consumer: the simulate_in_process_revert_probe PyO3 binding) load this file and assert the recorded output. The fixture: executor injected with the 0xcafebabe REVERT stub (PUSH4 0xcafebabe; PUSH1 0x00; MSTORE; PUSH1 0x04; PUSH1 0x1c; REVERT) over a 2-hop V2 path against CacheDB<EmptyDB> (no RPC). The oracle is a RECORDED constant (no closed-form derivation — the revm EVM run is the truth); the byte-exact assertion is the parity contract. V4 slice deferred (gated on 5RI47E).

fixture._doc_runtime_bytecode: PUSH4 0xcafebabe; PUSH1 0x00; MSTORE; PUSH1 0x04 (len); PUSH1 0x1c (offset=28); REVERT — returns mem[28..32] = 0xcafebabe
